findings.summary: crates/app/tests/board.rs:ages_go_by_the_servers_clock: the new second-board assertion can't catch a `got` kept from the first read (`self.got.or(Some(Instant::now()))` in finish()). Both reads finish within the same second and server_now() counts whole seconds, so that mutant still passes. It would show later boards' ages too large. Live ages were right.
Carried from round 3, still true: no test covers the ureq request deadline or the stale line's wrapping. Both were observed working live (timeout: global, wrapped GitHub error).

AC-7 names the cluster, but the server has no cluster source yet, so that part is unexercised. AC-6's 'PR checks finish within 2 minutes' holds only with GITHUB_TOKEN: tokenless, server A's GitHub reads were 18:23:07, then 18:49:50. The egress proxy here reported a 15000/h limit for unauthenticated requests, so GitHub's real 60/h limit wasn't tested. The device-clock check used an LD_PRELOAD CLOCK_REALTIME shim (verify4-tru11/scripts/fakeclock.c).

Not from this diff: in a 1600 px window the Outcome and Blocked columns are past the right edge. Booking's real tickets (TRU-6, TRU-7 in Outcome) weren't visible until the proxy moved them. I didn't check whether the columns scroll.
